body.title: Clarifications regarding statatics
body.aiReason: Job requires statistical analysis, SEM/mediation, R/Python work—matches core data analysis skills and positioning; appears genuine with clear scope.
body.description:
The manuscript has now received reviewer comments, mainly concerning the statistical analyses you previously worked on. Could you please review the attached statistical comments and help us address them? The main points involve:
Sample size/power calculation and justification for SEM/mediation
Missing-data handling and different sample sizes
Change-score regression and a requested baseline-adjusted sensitivity analysis
Checking and correcting the SEM/mediation models, particularly Tables 6 and 7
Clarifying the mediation interpretation
Multiple testing/FDR reporting
Since you already worked on the original analyses, it would be very helpful if you could check the original data/output and re-run or correct any analyses where necessary.
